name: Mercury-Bellows Hub
core_rationale: Central thermal-compensator sanctuary town of Thermal Compensator Basin at [1, 1] where horologist engineers regulate concentric mercury bellows-towers above the Mercury Expansion Sump.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Silver-sheened cooling reflections around the central concentric brass bellows-tower

North.lock_message: Extreme thermal-bellows pressure swings across Thermocouple-Ridge Overlook unseat uncalibrated valves; Bellows-Director Quicksilver requires the Mercury Barometer Key before opening the northern manifold gate.

resident_npcs.name: Bellows-Director Quicksilver
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Mercury-Bellows Hub! Step up to my 0.58 meter barometer console—our concentric brass bellows rise and fall two full meters between dawn and dusk.

resident_npcs.name: Manifold-Tinker Lyra
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Mercury Expansion Sump, an over-pressurized thermal colossus holds the Mercury Barometer Key needed to unlock Thermocouple-Ridge Overlook!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Thermal Compensator Basin at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Mercury Expansion Sump and connects west to Radiator Manifold Span.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Concentric brass bellows-towers and silver barometer columns breathing in rhythm with the desert sun.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m barometer consoles, 0.14m brass risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Thermocouple-Ridge Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
